select * from ( select '1' as type, a.apply_id as bizId, a.apply_no as bizNo, a.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, a.buyer_name as buyerName, a.buyer_tax_number as buyerTaxNumber, a.invoice_type as invoiceType, null as redReason, a.apply_status as status, null as confirmStatus, (select i.total_price_tax from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.apply_id = a.apply_id order by i.invoice_id desc limit 1) as amountDisplay, (select count(1) from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.apply_id = a.apply_id) as ticketCount, a.fail_reason as failReason, a.create_time as createTime, a.update_time as updateTime from t_invoice_apply a left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id where a.del_flag = '0' union all select '2' as type, r.red_apply_id as bizId, r.red_apply_no as bizNo, o.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, o.buyer_name as buyerName, o.buyer_tax_number as buyerTaxNumber, null as invoiceType, r.red_reason as redReason, r.red_status as status, r.confirm_status as confirmStatus, (select i.total_price_tax from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.red_apply_id = r.red_apply_id order by i.invoice_id desc limit 1) as amountDisplay, (select count(1) from t_invoice i where i.del_flag = '0' and i.red_apply_id = r.red_apply_id) as ticketCount, r.fail_reason as failReason, r.create_time as createTime, r.update_time as updateTime from t_red_apply r left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id where r.del_flag = '0' ) rec
and rec.type = #{q.type} and rec.status = #{q.status} and rec.enterpriseId = #{q.enterpriseId}
and rec.enterpriseName like concat('%', #{q.enterpriseName}, '%')
and rec.buyerName like concat('%', #{q.buyerName}, '%')
and rec.invoiceType = #{q.invoiceType} and rec.bizNo like concat('%', #{q.applyNo}, '%')
and exists (select 1 from t_invoice i2 where i2.del_flag = '0' and i2.invoice_no like concat('%', #{q.invoiceNo}, '%') and ((rec.type = '1' and i2.apply_id = rec.bizId) or (rec.type = '2' and i2.red_apply_id = rec.bizId)))
and rec.createTime >= #{q.startTime} and rec.createTime <= #{q.endTime}
order by rec.createTime desc
